Cinematic 16:9 social-first lifestyle frame, modern editorial beauty-campaign energy, handheld with slight micro-shake, captured mid-stride. SCARLETT wears a pale white kiosk uniform polo with a small chest logo, collar loose, hem half-tucked into denim cutoff shorts, bare legs, rubber thongs on her feet, an elastic hair tie around one wrist and a ring of kiosk keys hooked on her belt loop, coral lipstick on her mouth. She strides fast along the top of a low white-painted concrete sea wall walkway, one arm extended straight toward camera holding a phone in a selfie grip, other arm swinging back, weight on the front foot, torso torqued, hair lifting sideways in the wind, chin turning to glance directly into the lens mid-step with her lips parted on a half-breath, all potential energy about to break into the next stride. Behind her the wide bleached grey-white concrete promenade runs off into the distance beside a low rendered sea wall and thin steel railing, pale sand and breaking turquoise surf beyond, two or three surfers cresting a wave in the mid-ground, distant headland and pale apartment blocks compressed on the horizon under a hard cloudless blue sky, faint salt haze and airborne spray catching the light. High hard late-morning sunlight from above and slightly behind, strong crisp contrast with clean directional shadows on concrete, sparkling specular highlights scattered across the water, bright high-key exposure with lifted airy shadows, warm natural skin tones, true-to-life clean color grade, coral accent popping against grey-white and blue neutrals. Shot on a 35mm lens at eye-level, slightly wide, moderately shallow depth of field keeping her sharp while the surf softens, fine 35mm film grain.
